verdict.rationale: Privacy posture, including telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out, is a fair question for an API platform that ships SDKs, an MCP server and a developer portal. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics collection or any opt-out control. The pack only covers financial data APIs, webhooks, onboarding, testing and the MCP toolkit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
